description: EU public contracts awarded, from official TED contract award notices: who won, the buyer, value, CPV codes, country, award and contract dates and lots, each with the notice link and a SHA-256 proof of the TED answer. Use since (YYYY-MM-DD) for new awards, and filter by CPV code or prefix, buyer country, or winner (company name prefix or official identifier) to answer "has company X won anything since D". Pass next_cursor back as cursor to page or to poll for awards stored since. Uses the free tier, or the caller's API key.

country.description: Buyer country, 3-letter ISO code as TED uses, e.g. DEU, FRA, POL

cpv.description: CPV code or prefix, 2 to 8 digits, e.g. 72 for IT services; up to 5, comma-separated

since.description: Awards published on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD (default: 7 days ago; about 45 days are kept)

winner.description: Winning company's name, or its beginning, e.g. Mennica Polska

winner_id.description: Winning company's official identifier as given in the notice, e.g. a VAT or company number

name: eu_contract_awards
title: EU public-contract winners
